t: This is St Peter's Italian Church, a Roman Catholic basilica-style church on Clerkenwell Road, in Saffron Hill. It sits just inside the Camden boundary, but it's particularly associated with the Italian community of Clerkenwell, whose hub lies in Islington. The church is named for Saint Peter, the apostle who appears prominently in all four gospels and was one of the first leaders of the early Christian Church. Catholic and Orthodox tradition treats him as the first bishop of Rome, which is a fitting patron for an Italian congregation's church.
